description: Defines the absl::exponential_distribution class template for generating exponentially distributed random numbers, including parameter handling, distribution logic, and I/O operators.

classes.name: exponential_distribution
classes.description: A template class for generating exponential distribution random numbers with configurable floating-point type.

classes.name: exponential_distribution::param_type
classes.description: Holds distribution parameters, primarily lambda, with comparison operators.

methods.description: Generates a random number following the exponential distribution using a provided random number generator.
